title: 第11章 圣水中学第12章 都知道了
lines: 第11章圣水中学
乔桑痛心疾首。
这就是你突然攻击电视机的原因吗！
她抬起火牙狗的脑袋准备好好教育一番。
“咔。”门开了。
乔桑缓缓转过头，僵硬地笑了笑，“妈，你回来了。”
胖家鸠立马来到母亲面前撒娇般地蹭了蹭。
母亲看着客厅的惨状沉默了几秒，偏头看向乔桑和善道：“你有什么要说的吗？”
乔桑立马举起火牙狗挡在自己面前，“都是它干的！”
火牙狗眨了眨单纯的大眼睛。
母亲与火牙狗对视了片刻，道：“从你零用钱里扣。”
乔桑幽怨地看着她。
“你有什么意见吗？”母亲问道。
“没有。”乔桑昧着良心回答道。
一个月零用钱就1000联盟币，电视机起码4000多联盟币，一下子没了四个月的零用钱她当然有意见。
“我去了趟你学校。”母亲走过来坐在了一旁的单人沙发上，胖家鸠也跟了上来。
“是有什么事吗？”乔桑问道。
方思思在发来的消息里倒是提了一下这事。
母亲没有回答这个问题，而是问道：“你有什么想上的高中吗？”
乔桑微愣，想了想说道：“杭港第六御兽中学。”
第六御兽中学不是在杭港市排名第六的中学，只是单纯叫这样的名字而已，实力排名在整个杭港市1所有的御兽高中里属于中等水平。
选这个学校纯粹就是离家近罢了。
要是按照乔桑以前的成绩这样的学校肯定是考不上的，不过她现在自主觉醒了，通过特招倒是可以试一试。
母亲从随身的包里拿出一张招生简介放在乔桑面前，“我觉得你可以试试考这个学校。”
乔桑拿起来看了看，眼角一抽。
“杭港圣水中学？”
母亲面不改色道：“对。”
“妈，你是不是太看得起我了？”乔桑无奈道。
她将手中的招生简介放到茶几上。
圣水中学，杭港市108所御兽高中里排名第一，整个浙海省排名第二的御兽高中，升学率高达98.73%，是数一数二的名校。
能考上这所学校的学子自然都是杭港市尖子中的尖子。
要是现在离中考还有半年乔桑也愿意努力一把，可加上今天距离中考满打满算也只有19天时间，这完全没可能考上啊。
既然如此，为什么要浪费时间抽空去考这个学校的特招。
乔桑不理解，就算她是自主觉醒，母亲是不是对她期望过于不切实际了。
母亲看着乔桑平静道：“你报名，不用考上，只要尽力了这零用钱我就不扣你的了。”
乔桑拿起茶几上的招生简介说道：“什么零用钱不零用钱的，我就是想试一试。”
母亲嘴角抽了抽，“那你现在就去网上报名吧。”
“好嘞。”乔桑抱起火牙狗就走。
叶湘婷看着女儿的背影眼里闪过笑意，转念想起下午在学校发生的事情面色又沉了下来。
乔桑来到房间打开电脑，分别报了杭港第六御兽中学和圣水中学。
这两所学校排名相差大，特招的要求也不一样。
乔桑主要看了自主觉醒特招这一栏。
content_en:
Chapter 11 Shengshui Middle School
Qiao Sang was heartbroken.
Is this why you suddenly attacked the TV!
She raised the Fire Tooth Dog's head and prepared to teach him a lesson.
"Click." The door opened.
Qiao Sang slowly turned his head and smiled stiffly, "Mom, you are back."
"Dove!"
Fat Jiu immediately came to his mother and nuzzled her like a baby.
The mother looked at the tragic scene in the living room and was silent for a few seconds. She turned her head to look at Qiao Sang and said kindly: "Do you have anything to say?"
Qiao Sang immediately raised the Fire Fang Dog in front of him, "It did it all!"
The fire-toothed dog blinked its innocent big eyes.
The mother and the fire-toothed dog looked at each other for a moment and said, "Deduct it from your pocket money."
Qiao Sang looked at her resentfully.
"Do you have any opinion?" Mother asked.
"No." Qiao Sang replied without conscience.
A month's pocket money is only 1,000 alliance coins, and the TV set is at least more than 4,000 alliance coins. Of course she has objections to losing four months of pocket money.
"I went to your school." Mother came over and sat on the single sofa nearby, and Fat Jiu followed her.
"Is something wrong?" Qiao Sang asked.
Fang Sisi mentioned this matter in the message she sent.
Instead of answering the question, my mother asked, "Is there any high school you want to go to?"
Qiao Sang was stunned for a moment, then thought for a moment and said, "Hanggang No. 6 Beast Control Middle School."
The Sixth Royal Beast Middle School is not the sixth-ranked middle school in Hanggang City, it is just called such a name. Its strength ranking is at the middle level among all the Royal Beast High Schools in Hanggang City.
I chose this school simply because it was close to home.
Based on Qiao Sang's previous results, she would definitely not be able to get into a school like this, but now that she has awakened on her own, she can give it a try through special recruitment.
Mother took out an admissions brochure from her bag and placed it in front of Qiao Sang, "I think you can try this school."
Qiao Sang picked it up and looked at it, his eyes twitching.
"Hanggang Shengshui Middle School?"
Mother said without changing her expression: "Yes."
"Mom, do you think too highly of me?" Qiao Sang said helplessly.
She put the admissions brochure in her hand on the coffee table.
Shengshui Middle School ranks first among the 108 Royal Beast High Schools in Hanggang City, and ranks second among the entire Zhehai Province. The admission rate is as high as 98.73%, making it one of the most prestigious schools.
The students who can get into this school are naturally the best among the best in Hanggang City.
If there was still half a year before the high school entrance examination, Qiao Sang would be willing to work hard, but in addition, there are only 19 days until the high school entrance examination, so it is completely impossible to pass the entrance examination.
In this case, why waste time and spare time to take the special recruitment test of this school.
Qiao Sang didn't understand whether her mother's expectations of her were too unrealistic even if she awakened on her own.
Mother looked at Qiao Sang and said calmly: "You don't have to pass the exam if you sign up. As long as you do your best, I won't deduct your pocket money."
Qiao Sang picked up the admissions brochure on the coffee table and said, "There's nothing about pocket money. I just want to give it a try."
The corner of my mother's mouth twitched, "Then you can sign up online now."
"Okay." Qiao Sang picked up the fire-toothed dog and left.
Ye Xiangting looked at her daughter's back with a smile in her eyes. Then she thought about what happened at school in the afternoon and her face darkened again.
…
Qiao Sang came to the room and turned on the computer, and applied to Hanggang No. 6 Royal Beast Middle School and Shengshui Middle School respectively.
The rankings of the two schools are quite different, and the requirements for special recruitment are also different.
Qiao Sang mainly looked at the column of autonomous awakening special moves.
